gate_type: ARCHITECTURE / DESIGN / ROADMAP GATE — DOCUMENTATION & EVIDENCE ONLY (NO PRODUCTION IMPLEMENTATION)
objective: Freeze the SH WTP target mapping onto the completed vNext architecture (ARCH-01..05) and produce the ordered, dependency-aware implementation roadmap that follows the architecture program. Answer two questions: (1) can the frozen Platform->Workspace->Scope->Object, runtime composition, Observation/Event/Capability, UI, and migration rules represent SH WTP WITHOUT a new platform architecture decision? (2) what exact implementation gates follow, in what order, with what dependencies and acceptance evidence? Preserve: SH-WTP = Workspace; process areas/units = hierarchical Simulation Scopes (site topology evidence-dependent); Continuous/Batch/Discrete = archetypes, not one-engine-per-workspace; shared core owns execution/composition framework while SH-WTP domain physics stays domain-specific; PIM remains semantic authority (version-pinned, fail-closed); fidelity ceiling stays logical_only unless later evidence authorizes higher; legacy WTP mini-engines are reference/legacy, not target runtime; no invented site truth; ASSY regression protection kept throughout.
explicit_non_objectives: No SH WTP runtime/domain model implementation
No deletion/refactor of legacy WTP mini-engines
No invented SH WTP site topology/parameters/control logic
No fidelity raise beyond accepted evidence
No beginning of any implementation gate
forbidden_actions: Delete or refactor legacy WTP mini-engines
Invent SH WTP site topology/parameters/control logic
stop_conditions: SH WTP cannot map to ARCH-01..05 without a new platform architecture decision
Accepted PIM/VF contracts conflict materially with the target mapping
Current WTP paths require an Owner/SA choice between incompatible architectures
Roadmap dependency order cannot avoid premature SH WTP/domain implementation
Closing architecture would hide an unresolved platform-level gap
Safe mapping requires inventing plant/site truth

acceptance_criteria.description: SH WTP maps onto frozen architecture without new platform concepts
Current continuous/WTP seams and duplicate paths classified with clear future disposition
PIM/semantic-binding dependencies explicit and consistent with accepted contracts
Continuous observation/event/capability/UI mappings explicit and evidence-safe
Implementation roadmap ordered, dependency-aware and gate-sized
Each future gate has clear acceptance evidence expectations
No production code or implementation started
